quarterly_data.quarter: MindWalk press release: MindWalk Brings OpenFold3 into Production in Minutes with (09-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: MindWalk ran a production deployment of the open-source OpenFold3 structure-prediction model on Vultr Kubernetes Engine and Vultr Cloud GPU powered by AMD Instinct MI325X GPUs, delivered through AMD Inference Microservices (AIM), with AMD and Vultr (named as engineering partners), across its own protein, RNA, DNA, ligand and antibody-antigen workloads. A production-grade prediction environment deployed in minutes and antibody-antigen inference ran approximately 5x faster than in MindWalk's prior environment (results reflect the configurations evaluated). The release says Vultr and AMD form the compute fabric beneath MindWalk's platform and the deployment expands the compute capacity beneath ReefIQ as enterprise adoption scales. CEO Jennifer Bath: a partner's programs can now be running in minutes instead of waiting on a custom build, and MindWalk's costs do not have to climb with every partner it adds.
quarterly_data.figure: antibody-antigen inference ~5x faster; AMD Instinct MI325X GPUs; environment deployed in minutes
